explanation: The second column v must satisfy (A+I)v≠0 and (A+I)^2v=0. Here (A+I)y=z and (A+I)z=0, so y forms the required length-two Jordan chain. In contrast, (A+I)^2x=(0,0,9)^T≠0, while z is already an eigenvector and cannot be the second column. The columns z, y, and (0,0,1)^T form an invertible P.
